summary: Reduce local trim metadata write amplification

schema.detail: No schema, index or store version changes.

rules.detail: Retention, chunk budgets and daily deletion limits are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Trim cursor and daily counter retain their existing keys and values. Missing keys are still inserted; existing keys are updated in place only when their values change.

recovery.detail: Cursor progress and the daily counter still commit atomically with each deletion chunk. Recording and trimming recovery states are unchanged.
